hero.why: It's on your watchlist and just finished dropping — the last 3 eps landed 6/24, so you can start it tonight and binge without waiting. S4 set a Rotten Tomatoes record: fourth consecutive 100% RT season (no other Prime original has done that), 94% audience. Fantasy + witty banter + ensemble + adult-animated with dark humor = the Solar Opposites / Good Omens / Rick and Morty overlap that consistently lands 4★+ for you.
